source.snippet: Our PDP and PLP pages are sometimes failing LCP or INP in real-user/field data. However, when we test the same pages using PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse lab testing, the results show as Good/Passed. We have already made several performance optimizations, but we're still seeing the difference between the lab results and real-user data. (Magento, 2026-09-24)

problem_statement: E-commerce developers and SEO agencies working on Magento sites struggle to reconcile lab performance test results with real-user Core Web Vitals field data, leading to SEO ranking risk and wasted optimization cycles.
target_segment: Magento e-commerce developers, SEO agencies, and in-house digital teams at online retailers who are accountable for Core Web Vitals scores affecting Google search rankings.
notes: Buyer signal: Magento agencies and e-commerce teams have direct revenue tied to search rankings — a CWV failure translates to lost organic traffic and lost sales. These teams pay for SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog at $100-500+/month). The lab-vs-field gap is a well-documented, recurring pain point with no dedicated tooling that bridges the two in an actionable way for Magento specifically. A Magento-native real-user monitoring + CWV fix-prioritization tool or managed performance audit service has clear paying buyers.
